source: Frozen libsodium-wrappers-sumo output. No public KAT exists for crypto_box_seal because the ephemeral X25519 keypair is freshly generated at encryption time and ciphertext is therefore non-deterministic. This fixture covers (a) decryption of a frozen ciphertext yields the expected plaintext, (b) ciphertext length matches the 32-byte ephemeral pubkey + plaintext + 16-byte tag structure.
